description: Set within the highly sought-after waterfront community of Bel Marin Keys, this updated single-level residence offers effortless living in an exceptionally peaceful setting. Thoughtfully designed for both everyday comfort and entertaining, the expansive floor plan features generous open living and dining spaces, along with an eat-in kitchen, all seamlessly connected to the outdoors through multiple glass doors that create a true indoor-outdoor lifestyle. Skylights flood the home with natural light, enhancing the bright and airy interiors. The updated kitchen is both stylish and functional, featuring new cabinetry, quartz countertops, stainless steel appliances including a gas range, and a spacious pantry. The flexible floor plan offers four bedrooms, including two with updated en-suite baths, along with space for a dedicated home office. At the rear, the home backs to the creek and captures views of rolling greenery beyond, creating a rare sense of privacy and tranquility. Bel Marin Keys residents enjoy an exceptional waterfront lifestyle with lagoon access for kayaking, paddleboarding, and boating, along with cherished community events throughout the year.
